H-LOG 2026.08.11 [EN]

📈 [2026-08-11 17:07]

H-LOG: Professionals Report

the cash session (Spot)

  • Situation on indices and flows: The market is in a consolidation phase with a slight supply advantage. The NDX index (29633.40, +0.04%) and NQ contracts (29740.50, +0.01%) show almost zero price change, with a simultaneous negative cumulative energy flow (CVD) on NDX (-33,83 M) and QQQ (-1,14 M). This indicates the presence of selling pressure, which is currently being absorbed by the market, preventing a clear sell-off.
  • Sentiment and broad market: The aggregate flow direction indicator is -8, confirming the dominance of capital distribution. An extremely negative TICKQ reading at -296.00 (with a SMA200 average of 114.78) suggests strong dominance of downward moves across the broad Nasdaq spectrum and a lack of internal market strength to continue the upward trend.
  • Options market analysis: The QQQ options market indicates increasing caution. The Put/Call Volume Ratio at 1.11 suggests a prevalence of hedging positions or speculative bets on declines. With a volume of 1 856 973 and implied volatility (IV) at 20.29%, the market is pricing in an expected range of movement between 716.14 and 727.50 points.
